paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation of ChatGPT vs various algorithms," compares the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools—VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT—on the same task. The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms, while the vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.4 to 1.0. Each algorithm is represented by a distinct bar: VADER by a white bar, TextBlob by a bar with diagonal hatching, and ChatGPT by a solid green bar. The chart shows that VADER and TextBlob have similar accuracy, both with values around 0.7. In contrast, ChatGPT achieves a significantly higher accuracy, with its bar reaching a value of approximately 0.95. The legend in the upper right corner clearly identifies each algorithm by its corresponding bar style.
